log: The Research ProcessYield rule gains a criterion that the city's player is not under Anarchy, so research from trade and from Scientists doesn't reach the player's research. Yields themselves are unchanged.
`getRules` takes a new trailing `playerGovernmentRegistry` argument, passed from `game.playerGovernments`. Adds `civ1-government` and `core-government` dependencies. Rome on 640K a Day p217.

Build on push with pnpm on Node 22 without a lock file, as civ1-government and civ1-wonder do; make `prettier:check` actually check; remove `yarn.lock` and `.yarnrc.yml`, which nothing reads after the switch (decided on civ-clone/web-renderer#66).

The Gold ProcessYield rule (now `civ1-treasury:city/process-yield/gold`) gains a criterion that the city's player is not under Anarchy, so neither income nor CityImprovementMaintenanceGold reaches the treasury, and an unaffordable improvement is not sold during Anarchy. Yields themselves are unchanged, so the city still shows the gold it would have made.
